newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Taeil unveils new office machine engine.
newsitem.headline: Taeil unveils new office machine engine.

text.p: South Korea's Taeil Media Co said on Wednesday it had developed a new multi-function engine for office machines and expected to record more than $300 million in domestic sales and exports per year.
A Taeil statement said the Multi Function Peripheral engine, which also can be built into personal computers, has been developed over two years at an investment of 9.5 billion won.
Taeil said a single unit of the new engine offers four different functions of a laser beam printer, facsimile machine, image scanner and copy machine.
Taeil is South Korea's largest maker of personal computer parts and the world's leading producer of magnetic heads for computer disk drives.
The statement said the company plans to double its monthly production capacity for the engine to 100,000 units. It did not give a time frame for the capacity expansion.
It said the new device was expected to hit the market in the second half of this year.
